Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs · documents: The v1 paper reports a four-stage chart selection process: SigLIP similarity filtering of figures extracted from January 2020–September 2023 arXiv preprints, graduate-student selection for visual diversity, removal of near-duplicates, and exclusion of blurry or unclearly labeled charts.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.charxiv.paper.chart-selection

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator identity/disposition are pending. No replication, independent rights adjudication, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit.
  • The reported similarity cutoffs are at least 0.65 for candidates and at least 0.95 for duplicate removal. These are author-reported construction rules; the underlying corpus was not independently reprocessed.

CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs · documents: The v1 paper uses GPT-4o to extract responses and assign binary correctness grades rather than exact string matching, and acknowledges that automated grading errors or human participant mistakes may affect its measurements.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.charxiv.paper.grading-and-limitations

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator identity/disposition are pending. No replication, independent rights adjudication, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit.
  • No grade or model result was rerun. Its model versions, image resolutions, generation settings, prompts, and grading rules are version-specific; this is not evidence of current model performance or perfect gold labels.
